parts.title: Part 1
parts.transcriptHtml:
MAN: Morning, Kingstown tourist information. This is David speaking. How can I help you?

WOMAN: Oh, Hi. Look, I'm coming to Kingstown on holiday and wondered if you could give me some information about tours.

MAN: Yes, of course. Is there anything particular you're interested in?

WOMAN: Well, I heard there was a Glowworm tour.

MAN: Yes, indeed. It's $93 and lasts for 3 hours.

WOMAN: And what are the main activities?

MAN: Well, the first thing is traveling to the other side of the lake.

WOMAN: You mean by boat?

MAN: No, it's the {[little train][1]} that runs along the shore of the lake. It's very popular.

WOMAN: Oh, my children will love that.

MAN: And that's how you get round to the caves. This is where the glow worms live. So you spend some time exploring the caves and looking at the remarkable lights and patterns given off by the worms in the dark.

WOMAN: That does sound interesting. And any other information?

MAN: Just one thing. How old are your children?

WOMAN: Seven and ten. Why?

MAN: No, that's okay. It's just that children {[must be five or older][2]} to go in the caves. Otherwise they might get scared in the dark, but yours will be fine.

WOMAN: Okay, well, that's one to think about. And what about Silver Fjord? That's so famous. We'd like to go there.

MAN: Well, a day trip costs $220.

WOMAN: And how do we travel down to the Fjord?

MAN: That's a lot more expensive, I'm afraid. On {[this tour you go in a coach][3]}. It's about a two hour drive through fantastic scenery.

WOMAN: Do we get a break? I think my children might get a bit bored.

MAN: Yes. You stop at Easten.

WOMAN: That's to {[take a walk][4]}, is it?

MAN: Yes. There is a nice path by the river. You stop in Eastern for half an hour, so there's plenty of time.

WOMAN: That sounds nice.

MAN: So then you get down to Silver Fjord and you really spend most of the day going for a cruise on the Fjord. It's spectacular mountain scenery. And you also cruise past a {[huge waterfall][5]}, which is another highlight of the day.

WOMAN: Well, that does sound amazing. And should we bring our own food or is lunch provided?

MAN: No, lunch is included. It's a barbecue on the boat.

WOMAN: And what about marine life?

MAN: Yes. You'll definitely see seals

WOMAN: Dolphins?

MAN: No, not in that part of the country. But if you're lucky, there will be {[whales][6]} as well.

WOMAN: Oh, well, my kids would absolutely love that.

MAN: Then another popular option is the High Country Tour. That's $105.

WOMAN: Oh, I heard about this. You visit a historic home, don't you?

MAN: Yes, that's right. And they serve you lunch.

WOMAN: Is that actually inside the house?

MAN: No. At this time of year, it'll be the {[garden][7]}, which is really pretty.

WOMAN: Oh, I like the sound of that.

MAN: Yes, it's a really great meal, apparently.

WOMAN: And what about in the afternoon,

MAN: You go up and have a look around the {[farm][8]}. It's just close to the house.

MAN: So if you're from the city, it's a chance to really see what life is like here. The High Country Tour gets excellent reviews from visitors.

WOMAN: Great. So then what about the zip line? My children really want to do that. How much is it?

MAN: The zip line is $75.

WOMAN: And is it safe?

MAN: Absolutely. You are suspended from the wire in a special harness, and then you just glide down the wire.

WOMAN: My friend said that below you. You've got this amazing {[ancient forest][9]}.

MAN: That's right. And it's really special to see it from above. Not something we do very often if you think about it.

WOMAN: No, I suppose that's true. And I mean, how fast do you go?

MAN: Hang on. I've got the information here. 68 km an hour.

WOMAN: That doesn't mean much to me. What's that in miles?

MAN: Oh, yes, it's here in miles per hour. It's about {[43][10]}.

WOMAN: Wow. My kids will definitely want to do that. Okay, well, look, I'll just talk it over with my husband in
